Why Should I Choose Smock HVAC?

At Smock HVAC, we’re a family owned & operated mentality. Our family values are the core of what we do. We believe every individual deserves trustworthy service and courteous interactions. Customer care is what we do best!

What Services Do You Offer?

We offer installation and maintenance services for all heating, cooling, water heater, and air quality products.

Do You Provide Financing?

Yes! Visit our financing page to learn more. (Subject to credit approval)

Do Your Services Come With A Warranty?

All of our work comes with a minimum 1 year service warranty.

What Heating Services Do You Offer?

We offer installation and repair services for a variety of heating fixtures. 


What Do I Need To Know About Your Maintenance Plans?

Smock’s Comfort Plan is designed to provide you with reliable care that keeps your home running smoothly. We offer 15% discounts on all services repairs to members, and eliminate all overtime fees. 


What Areas Do You Serve?

We provide service all throughout Frederick County and parts of Howard County, Montgomery County, Carroll County and Washington County.


What Are Some Signs That I Need Heat Pump Repair?

 In general, if your heat pump is acting unusually it’s always better to have it examined by an HVAC professional. Look out for poor airflow, strange noises, and inconsistent heating and cooling. 


Do You Offer Emergency Service?

While our repairs are performed during regular business hours, we take calls 24/7 and can help advise you on next steps

FAQ
What should I look for when hiring a roofing contractor?

Look for four things above all: proper licensing and insurance, manufacturer certifications, a local track record, and transparent, documented pricing. These are exactly the standards we hold ourselves to at Veterans Contracting. We’re fully licensed and insured, we partner with trusted manufacturers like Owens Corning and Elevate to back our work with extended warranties, and we have a proven local track record. We put every estimate in writing, document the condition of your roof with photos, and give you a straight recommendation rather than steering you toward the most expensive job. If a contractor won’t do those things, that’s your sign to keep looking.

FAQ
What should I look for when hiring a roofing contractor?

Look for four things above all: proper licensing and insurance, manufacturer certifications, a local track record, and transparent, documented pricing. These are exactly the standards we hold ourselves to at Veterans Contracting. We’re fully licensed and insured, we partner with trusted manufacturers like Owens Corning and Elevate to back our work with extended warranties, and we have a proven local track record. FAQ
What should I look for when hiring a roofing contractor?

Look for four things above all: proper licensing and insurance, manufacturer certifications, a local track record, and transparent, documented pricing. These are exactly the standards we hold ourselves to at Veterans Contracting. We’re fully licensed and insured, we partner with trusted manufacturers like Owens Corning and Elevate to back our work with extended warranties, and we have a proven local track record. We put every estimate in writing, document the condition of your roof with photos, and give you a straight recommendation rather than steering you toward the most expensive job. If a contractor won’t do those things, that’s your sign to keep looking.

DR

Dave R.

July 14th, 2026

What a great experience working with Home front Exteriors !

Thank all!

KJ

Kelsey J.

August 19th, 2026

Fantastic people to work with. Highly recommend!

October 22, 2026

We highly recommend Home Front Exteriors for their quality work and great customer service.

I would highly recommend Home Front Exteriors for any home exterior project! We have recommended to our neighbors and friends just for the trust we have in them.

before.text:
Kreipiausi dėl vejos sutvarkymo, po prasto kitų „vejos specialistų“ įrengimo. Greitai atvyko apžiūrėti ir įvertinti, pasakė, ką reikia daryti, pateikė sąmatą ir atlikimo terminus, ir po savaitės nuo pirmo skambučio darbai jau atlikti. Rekomenduoju.

Mantas R.
2026 m. birželio 22 d.
Paslaugos.lt

Veja gavo pilną priežiūrą: core aeraciją, skarifikavimą, atsėjimą ir levelingą. Levelingo metu veja nebuvo suguldyta, viskas atlikta tvarkingai ir atsakingai. Po darbų kiemas buvo pilnai sutvarkytas. Stipriai rekomenduoju dirbti su Tomu.

Daugardas B.
2026 m. gegužės 4 d.
Paslaugos.lt

Darbas atliktas kruopščiai, kokybiškai ir tvarkingai. Po darbų atlikimo aplinką paliko švaresnę negu buvo. Rekomenduoju.

Al Bert
2026 m. birželio 1 d.
Paslaugos.lt

Puikiai atliko vejos skarifikavimą ir aeravimą. Dirba kruopščiai ir atidžiai. Malonus bendravimas, pakonsultavo vejos priežiūros klausimais.

Laura V.
2026 m. balandžio 29 d.
Paslaugos.lt

Aiški komunikacija nuo pirmo kontakto. Mažai kalba ir daug daro. Geras kainos ir kokybės santykis. Rekomenduoju.

Lukas N.
2026 m. balandžio 20 d.
Paslaugos.lt

Greitai bei tvarkingai atlikta užsakyta skarifikavimo paslauga. Kaina atitinka kokybę.

Rimvydas
2026 m. birželio 4 d.
Paslaugos.lt

limitations: Automated discovery uses homepage navigation; null page roles mean no distinct matching navigation link, not proof that a page does not exist.
not-present interaction means no supported selector matched, not an exhaustive proof of absence.
Native reportValidity does not exercise custom submit-handler validation. Required fields can take focus before an invalid email/phone. Phone fields may have no native pattern.
Embedded frame forms inventoried, not fully exercised. Only the first modal screen is inspected; no scheduler steps advanced.
Motion sampling occurs after earlier interactions; normal and reduced samples are not a frame-perfect load comparison.
Screenshots preserve cookie banners; none were consented to. Fixed element rectangles are recorded; occlusion of content or submit buttons requires visual review.
Not all screenshots have been visually reviewed. Findings are observation-based leads for design review, not final design recommendations.
